convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for SimpleBars indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Custom indicator logic is opaque without its source.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator bar for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is ready

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags allow disabling signal-based closes independently

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input value meaning changes based on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: SimpleBars buffer 4 returns color/trend state: Col[1]==0 with Col[0]==1 triggers buy (bullish reversal), Col[1]==1 with Col[0]==0 triggers sell (bearish reversal). Signal is read from bar index SignalBar (default 1 = previous closed bar). When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated every tick (intraday mode). Four input booleans (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) independently gate each direction's entry and exit. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles new bar detection. LoadHistory ensures history is loaded before signal evaluation.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reverse-engineering SimpleBars custom indicator logic (buffer 4 outputs 0=bullish state, 1=bearish state with buffer index [0] as transition flag). TradeAlgorithms.mqh position sizing (5 MM modes) and order management functions must be reimplemented. The CIsNewBar class and LoadHistory are boilerplate that map to standard Python bar-detection logic. SL/TP are in points (not pips) — verify broker digit convention. Signal bar offset of 1 means using previous bar's confirmed signal, safe for backtesting.
